scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,yellow "npm run start --workspace=web" "npm run dev --workspace=api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=web && npm run test --workspace=api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=web && npm run lint --workspace=api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@pottery/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=api
